text:
Sol Duarte: Hi everyone — Sol here, joining Platform as an SRE! Day one remote. My laptop shipping ETA got bumped, any quick way to get started pairing without hardware? Im on PST (UTC-8).
Marcus Li: Welcome Sol!! :tada: Ill check with hardware team for a loaner. Meanwhile I can spin up a dev VM and give you access. DMing creds.
devex-bot: Onboarding checklist created for @Sol Duarte  Please complete MDM enrollment, enable 2FA, and join #platform and #oncall-shadow. Handbook: https://intra.redwood/handbook/onboarding
Jamie Ortiz: Hey Sol  Im your onboarding buddy. Ill book a 30m intro and a quick walk-through of the stack at 10am PT. Coffee preference? :coffee:
Lia Chen: Welcome! HR note: benefits packet + payroll forms were sent. If you dont see them check spam or ping me. :wave:
Alex Romero: Quick SSH steps: if you have keys -> `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 sol@devvm.redwood`. If not: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "sol@redwood.com"` then paste your `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` in the onboarding form.
Sol Duarte: Got the VM creds, logging in now. Huge thanks Marcus and Alex. Jamie  oat milk latte please :blush: Standup is a bit early for me so Ill join after the intro session.
Marcus Li: Added you to the channels. If the loaner arrives later today well coordinate a swap. Ping me here if you hit any permission errors.
Jamie Ortiz: Team ritual: post a photo of your weird mug and one non-work fun fact. Also we do a one-week demo of something small youve enjoyed building. :mug:
Sol Duarte: Love that. Fun fact: I used to compete in bonsai shows and once cross-stitched a map of major ramen shops in my city. Will post mug + bonsai pic later. Excited to be here and meet everyone!
